title: How does a camera flash work?
cover: How does a camera flash work?

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: How is a flash SO bright?
short_scenes.narration: Volt's camera flash is far brighter than its tiny battery. How?
A capacitor charges slowly from the battery, watch the voltage climb. Then it dumps all that stored energy into the flash in a split second.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A capacitor stores energy, one half C V squared, and can release it almost instantly.
